class.name: WorldLakeDecorator
class.brief_description: Forms a grounded lake basin and closed banks at an independent water elevation.
class.description: Blends a complete bed and bank formation into the incoming signed field with a seeded irregular elliptical shoreline. Center Y is the water level and may be above or below sea level. This operation may add and remove ground to establish a grounded basin; later cave and river cuts still apply. Default priority -40 follows terrain profiles and precedes ordinary cuts. Container and ancestor scopes restrict terrain changes. Water meshes are separate render aids in authoring coordinates; callers apply instance transforms and residency. This does not simulate water volume, drainage, overflow or persistence.

method.name: create_water_mesh
method.description: Returns a horizontal water disk at center.y using the same seeded shoreline as the basin. A positive-volume [param bounds] clips triangles exactly in XZ, so adjacent loaded patches share an edge. Zero-volume bounds includes the entire lake; returns null if no geometry remains. Terrain scopes and instance transforms must also be respected by the caller.

method.name: conform_water_mesh
method.description: Returns a copy of [param mesh] with water vertices inside the lake shoreline flattened 0.02 metres below its level to avoid overlapping coplanar render surfaces. Used for static river ribbons crossing a standing lake. Does not alter terrain, route rivers or validate arbitrary water-level conflicts. Vertex layout, indices and surface materials are retained.

members.member: Outer blending distance along the smaller ellipse axis in metres. The larger-axis band scales with the ellipse. Must be greater than zero and at most 1024. Keeps the outer bank connected to incoming terrain.
Container-local lake center; Y specifies the standing water level independently of sea level. Terrain formation and water generation share this value.
Center-bed depth below water level in metres, greater than zero and at most 256. The floor rises toward the shoreline.
Elliptical basin radii in X and Z, each from 2 to 4096 metres. The water edge lies at 80 percent of these radii; the bank crest lies at the full radius.
Bank crest height above the water level in metres, greater than zero and at most 128.
Seeded angular shoreline distortion, from zero to 0.35. Zero produces an ellipse.
